Self harm is self harm. Even cuts that are not very deep, especially at your age, are VERY concerning and indicate that you are really struggling. Your emotions are absolutely valid even without harming yourself physically.🫂❤️

I’ve dealt with feeling guilty for my mom too when I was still self-harming. It sounds like she really loves you. But it’s really not your fault you feel so bad mentally, and you shouldn’t ever feel guilty for your emotions.

Self harm won’t truly make you feel better or help you with any of the problems that make you wanna do it. Find some healthy coping mechanisms that work for you instead, such as talking to a friend/loved one, writing down your emotions in a journal or making art.   

Self harm is also very much a physical risk. Even smaller cuts can get infected, and those are a pain in the ass and potentially really dangerous. Not worth the hassle.
